defaults.x: Accessible & Ethical, Soft UI Evolution, Editorial Grid / Magazine
defaults.c: Neutral ground so products lead, one action colour for the buy button, success and error colours with text
defaults.a: Add to basket and check out
defaults.t: Total price shown early, delivery and returns in plain words, real reviews with source, secure payment named, contact details
defaults.b: Guest checkout; quote or call for large orders

rows: E-commerce
ecommerce, shop, store, products, basket, checkout, delivery, returns
Show price, stock and delivery date on the product card. Offer guest checkout and wallets, and state returns before the pay step.
E-commerce Luxury
luxury ecommerce, premium retail, boutique, jewellery, designer, craftsmanship, gifting, concierge
Slow the page down: large photography, detailed materials, provenance and a human to speak to. Do not hide prices or delivery terms.

rows.x: Minimalism & Swiss Style, Photo-led Documentary, Dark Mode (OLED)

rows: Luxury/Premium Brand
luxury brand, premium, heritage, atelier, collection, bespoke, craft, house
Heritage claims need dates and facts. Let one image and one line carry the first screen, and keep contact personal.

rows.x: Minimalism & Swiss Style, Photo-led Documentary, Dark Mode (OLED)

rows: Digital Products/Downloads
digital products, downloads, templates, ebooks, licences, instant delivery, files, creators
Say what is in the file, what licence applies and how delivery works. Show previews and offer a refund policy for files.
Marketplace (P2P)
marketplace, peer to peer, buyers, sellers, listings, escrow, reviews, fees
Trust is the product: verified profiles, protected payments, clear dispute steps and published fees. Search and filters decide the visit.

rows.t: Seller verification, payment protection, dispute process, fees in numbers

rows: Classifieds / Buy-Sell
classifieds, buy and sell, listings, local, second hand, offers, safe meeting, categories
Local search, photos and a safe-meeting guide. Show scam warnings and how to report a listing.
Auction Platform
auction, bids, lots, reserve, countdown, live bidding, buyer premium, catalogue
Show the current bid, time left in words and fees in total. Countdown must be real and bids must confirm clearly.
Crowdfunding Platform
crowdfunding, campaign, backers, pledge, rewards, goal, creators, update
Show the goal, deadline and what happens if it falls short. Creators' history and plain risk statements build trust.
Directory / Listing Site
directory, listings, categories, search, profiles, claim listing, map, reviews
Search by place and category first. Each listing needs verified facts and a date checked, and owners need a way to claim and correct.
Review Platform
reviews, ratings, verified, stars, moderation, businesses, responses, trust
Explain how reviews are verified and moderated. Show distribution, not only an average, and give businesses a fair reply route.
Job Board/Recruitment
job board, recruitment, vacancies, salary, apply, employers, cv, alerts
Salary, place and remote status in the listing card. Application should take minutes, and employers need clear listing prices.
Freelancer Platform
freelancers, gigs, proposals, escrow, profiles, hire, projects, rates
Profile, rates and past work decide hires. Explain fees, payment protection and dispute steps for both sides.
Resume / CV Builder
resume builder, cv, templates, ats, export, cover letter, job search, pdf
Templates must be plain enough to be read by recruiting software. Export to PDF free of watermark, or say what costs.
Portfolio/Personal
portfolio, personal site, freelancer, designer, developer, projects, about, contact
Few strong projects with your role and the result. A clear way to contact and a short bio, and a site fast enough to be its own proof.

rows.s: Editorial Grid / Magazine + Minimalism & Swiss Style
rows.c: Whatever the work needs; a neutral frame is safest, with one accent

rows: Food Delivery / On-Demand
food delivery, on demand, restaurants, courier, order tracking, basket, fees, eta
Show total price with fees before checkout and a truthful arrival window. Tracking should update without refreshing.
Logistics/Delivery
logistics, delivery, freight, tracking, shipments, couriers, warehouse, quote
Tracking number search at the top and a quote form for shipping. Show service areas, transit times and what is not carried.

rows.a: Track a parcel or get a quote

rows: Agriculture/Farm Tech
agriculture, farm tech, crops, sensors, yield, irrigation, soil, farmers
Farmers read in a tractor cab and a field: large type, offline use and plain units. Show trials with yields and conditions.

rows.x: Nature Distilled, Data-Dense Dashboard, Accessible & Ethical

rows: Automotive/Car Dealership
car dealership, used cars, stock, finance, test drive, part exchange, vehicles, valuation
Stock search with real photos, price and mileage, then a test drive booking. State finance terms in full and give a valuation tool.

rows.d: none needed: stock managed in the dealer system
rows.t: Dealer licence, finance terms, warranty, vehicle history check

rows: Real Estate/Property
real estate, property, listings, agents, viewings, valuation, rent, buy
Search first, then viewing and valuation. Photos and floor plans must be the real property, and fees stated.

rows.s: Local Service Clear + Editorial Grid / Magazine
rows.t: Agent registration, redress scheme, fees, real photos

rows: Airline
airline, flights, booking, check in, baggage, status, loyalty, fares
Search flights at once and show total price with baggage. Check-in, status and disruption help must be a tap away.

rows.t: Licence and bonding, delivered price, baggage rules, disruption rights

rows: Ride Hailing / Transportation
ride hailing, taxi, driver, pickup, fare, route, eta, safety
Show the fare, pickup point and driver details before confirming. Safety sharing and receipts are core features.
Parking Finder
parking, car park, spaces, price, permits, navigation, reserve, ev
Live availability, price per hour and a clear map. Reserve ahead and show opening hours and height limits.
Public Transit Guide
public transit, bus, train, timetable, journey planner, live arrivals, tickets, stops
Next departures and disruptions first. Journey planner needs step-free options and offline timetables.
Road Trip Planner
road trip, route, stops, itinerary, fuel, camping, scenic, map
Build a route with stops and drive times, share with passengers and keep it available offline. Show fuel and charging stops.
Banking/Traditional Finance
bank, banking, accounts, savings, mortgage, branch, regulation, security
Say what is protected and by whom. Rates, fees and the regulator should be easy to find, and login must be calm and secure.

rows.t: Regulator, deposit protection, fees table, security summary

rows: Fintech/Crypto
fintech, crypto, wallet, trading, payments, exchange, assets, kyc
Say what is custodied, how fees work and the risks, including losses. Real-time prices must show source and time.

rows.x: Glassmorphism, Data-Dense Dashboard, Minimalism & Swiss Style
rows.t: Regulator, custody model, fee table, risk statement, audits

rows: Financial Dashboard
financial dashboard, kpi, cash flow, revenue, budget, reporting, accounts, forecast
Lead with the figures that decide actions: cash, runway, overdue. Show currency, period and source on every chart.
Personal Finance Tracker
personal finance, budget, spending, savings, accounts, categories, goals, bills
Never shame spending. Explain how bank data is accessed and how to disconnect it, and show money in plain currency.
Expense Splitter / Bill Split
expense splitter, bill split, shared costs, owe, settle, groups, receipts, trips
Show who owes whom in one line and let people settle in a tap. Support uneven splits and currencies.
NFT/Web3 Platform
nft, web3, wallet, mint, collection, chain, marketplace, smart contract
Show contract address, chain, royalties and fees up front, with plain risk wording. Do not hide gas costs.

rows.x: Glassmorphism, Cyberpunk UI, Gradient Mesh / Aurora Evolved
rows.t: Contract address, chain, audit link, fees and royalties, risk statement

rows: Healthcare App
healthcare app, patients, records, appointments, prescriptions, messages, care team, health
Privacy and clarity before features: who sees data, how to message the team and how to get urgent help. Plain language and large type.

rows.t: Regulator or provider name, privacy summary, clinician names, urgent help route

rows: Patient Portal / Health Records
results, health records, patient portal, appointments, prescriptions, messages, access, nhs
Secure log-in that works for older users, results shown with a plain explanation and a way to book or message. Proxy access for carers.

rows.b: Appointments and messages inside the portal

rows: Telemedicine Platform
telemedicine, video consultation, virtual clinic, prescriptions, remote care, doctors, triage
Test the video before the call, show the clinician's registration and a fallback phone number. Say what cannot be treated remotely.
Emergency SOS & Safety
emergency sos, safety, panic button, location sharing, contacts, alert, check in, help
The main button must work in seconds under stress with a confirm that cannot be missed. State limits: it does not replace emergency numbers.
Non-profit/Charity
non profit, charity, donate, volunteers, impact, fundraising, trustees, campaign
One true story, a donate button and where the money goes with a date. Show the registration number and the latest accounts.

rows.x: Accessible & Ethical, Editorial Grid / Magazine, Public Service Plain
rows.t: Registration number, latest accounts, trustees, where each gift goes

rows: Grant / Funding Portal
grants, funding, applications, eligibility, deadlines, funders, awards, portal
Eligibility check first, then deadlines and documents. Show application status and what happens after submission.
Government/Public Service
government, public service, citizens, forms, benefits, licences, council, official
Task-led, plain language, tested with real users and accessible to WCAG 2.2 AA. No hero image; links named by what people want to do.

rows.x: Inclusive Design, Minimalism & Swiss Style, Flat Design
rows.t: Official domain, accessibility statement, contact routes, last updated date

rows: Government Portal / Civic Services
civic services, government portal, applications, payments, permits, council tax, account, status
Let people finish a task without an account, then add an account for status. Show steps, fees and decision times.
Scanner & Document Manager
scanner, document scan, pdf, ocr, folders, sign, share, camera
Edge detection that works in poor light and export to PDF at a sane size. State where files are processed.
Voice Recorder & Memo
voice recorder, memo, audio, transcribe, notes, recording, trim, share
One big record button and a clear level meter. Offer transcripts with accuracy caveats and local storage.

rows.s: Minimalism & Swiss Style + Soft UI Evolution

rows: Translator App
translator, translate, languages, camera, voice, offline, phrases, dictionary
Offline packs, camera and voice, and confidence shown plainly. Warn that machine translation can mislead in medical and legal use.
Bookmark & Read-Later
bookmarks, read later, articles, tags, highlights, offline, reader mode, sync
Save in one tap from anywhere, read offline in a calm view, and export all bookmarks in an open format.
